title: ERROR IN PLUGIN - check logs for more info - v0.41.0
body:
# 2. Issues with the Zellij UI / behavior / crash

## Issue description
After update from prev version I get `ERROR IN PLUGIN - check logs for more info` when zellij starts, with default config.

```
ERROR IN PLUGIN - check logs for more info
┌ status-bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│Loading status-bar...                                                                                                                                                      │
│Attempting to load from memory... NOT FOUND                                                                                                                                │
│Attempting to load from cache... NOT FOUND                                                                                                                                 │
│Compiling WASM                                                                                                                                                             │
│ERROR:  failed to start plugin 1 for client 1                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                           │
│Caused by:                                                                                                                                                                 │
│    0: failed to recover cache dir                                                                                                                                         │
│    1: WebAssembly translation error                                                                                                                                       │
│    2: Invalid input WebAssembly code at offset 712955: reference-types not enabled: zero byte expected                                                                    │
│ERROR IN PLUGIN - check logs for more info
```

## Minimal reproduction
- remove all configs for zellij
- start zellij (without any parameter)

## Other relevant information
- using https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/releases/download/v0.41.0/zellij-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
- zellij is in `/usr/local/bin`
- PopOS running on Intel CPU
- terminal is wezterm, but the same happens in other terminals
```
Distributor ID: Pop
Description:    Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS
Release:        22.04
Codename:       jammy
```


How can I find the logs with the error?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Exact same issue on Arch updated via binstall.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Hi @reporter, thanks for the swift report. Naturally, this is important.
For general information, zellij logs should write to /$temp_dir/zellij-<UID>/zellij-log/zellij.log. in most systems $temp_dir, is /tmp with some expections (/var/folders/dr/ in MAC).

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
> reference-types not enabled: zero byte expected

Rust started using wasm reference-types by default in 1.82: https://blog.rust-lang.org/2024/09/24/webassembly-targets-change-in-default-target-features.html I think we need to enable the gc cargo feature of Wasmtime to make it able to handle wasm modules that use reference-types.

Thanks for the quick reply! Would you like to make a PR, or point me in the right direction? I don't have a lot of context on this.

comments.author: participant5
